name: Uvalde County, TX
findings: Uvalde County has 58 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Uvalde County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Uvalde County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 64% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
